description: The University of Bern and German Federal Institute of Hydrology publish Hydro-CH2018-Runoff, simulated discharge for 93 Swiss catchments during 1981–2099. PREVAH hydrological models were calibrated by catchment and driven by CH2018 climate scenarios. The repository lists 12 climate-model chains for RCP2.6, 25 for RCP4.5 and 30 for RCP8.5. A public 7Z archive contains daily series and monthly, seasonal and annual summaries, plus model-chain lists, gauge identifiers and filename documentation. Access is open and free under CC-BY-4.0. These are scenario-conditioned simulations, not observed future flow. Stationary calibration assumptions and duplicate-resolution climate chains create uncertainty; users should follow the article’s guidance before calculating ensemble statistics. The series could test hydropower, reservoir and water-supply performance under changing inflows. The existing data-com-droughts-swiss-catchment-drought-indices derives different indicators for only 52 catchments from these scenarios. That dependent product does not include the full 93-catchment runoff ensemble. No numerical files were downloaded.
